verdict.rationale: Fivetran's REST API and MCP server (with read/write/delete scopes) let an AI-native user script actions across multiple connectors, and docs mention a single Hybrid Deployment Agent managing multiple connections and copying existing connections to a new destination — both hint at bulk-style automation. However, there is no documented single bulk/batch endpoint or MCP tool that explicitly operates on 'many items at once' in one call. Missing for 10: an explicit bulk/batch API or MCP operation example, and independent or hands-on evidence that bulk operations across many connectors/items actually work smoothly.
